---
title: "Historical Population Pyramid"
source: "https://www.amcharts.com/demos/historical-population-pyramid/"
category: "miscellaneous"
scraped: "2026-10-08"
---

A population pyramid tied to a timeline: hover a year in the U.S. population chart and the pyramid redraws its age groups for that year, from 1950 to the UN projection for 2100.

Why link a pyramid to a timeline: A single pyramid is a snapshot; moving through the years shows how a population ages. Here the baby boom of the 1950s climbs the pyramid decade by decade, and the oldest group swells late in the century. The totals chart says how many, the pyramid says who.

Good for:
- How a population ages over decades
- Projections next to the history behind them
- Any breakdown that changes year by year

Think twice when:
- Printed reports: show a few chosen years side by side
- Few years of data: two pyramids compare better
- Exact numbers: a table of age groups

Prompt: Create a US population pyramid by sex and age group next to a timeline of the US population from 1950 to 2100, with the projected years dashed. Moving the cursor over the timeline redraws the pyramid for that year. Use the amCharts 5 library with its Responsive theme.

```javascript
  { year: 2085, male: [12161, 12117, 12086, 12249, 12552, 12792, 12856, 12797, 12773, 12802, 12809, 12696, 12342, 11653, 10789, 10486, 22985], female: [11608, 11568, 11543, 11727, 12064, 12339, 12435, 12404, 12403, 12459, 12507, 12463, 12205, 11628, 10895, 10752, 25721] },
  { year: 2086, male: [12176, 12141, 12111, 12258, 12548, 12802, 12888, 12829, 12782, 12794, 12799, 12706, 12399, 11756, 10818, 10432, 23146], female: [11623, 11593, 11570, 11738, 12060, 12347, 12464, 12434, 12412, 12450, 12498, 12472, 12259, 11729, 10922, 10701, 25878] },
  { year: 2087, male: [12195, 12160, 12132, 12264, 12544, 12807, 12916, 12866, 12796, 12787, 12788, 12710, 12443, 11853, 10906, 10353, 23299], female: [11642, 11613, 11592, 11745, 12056, 12351, 12490, 12467, 12423, 12443, 12486, 12475, 12300, 11822, 11007, 10620, 26040] },
  { year: 2088, male: [12213, 12176, 12145, 12264, 12538, 12808, 12940, 12903, 12812, 12782, 12776, 12708, 12476, 11941, 11033, 10271, 23461], female: [11660, 11628, 11605, 11744, 12050, 12350, 12510, 12501, 12437, 12435, 12471, 12470, 12328, 11905, 11129, 10533, 26226] },
  { year: 2089, male: [12226, 12189, 12150, 12255, 12530, 12804, 12956, 12937, 12831, 12778, 12762, 12699, 12497, 12019, 11167, 10224, 23646], female: [11672, 11639, 11608, 11734, 12040, 12345, 12524, 12530, 12452, 12428, 12453, 12456, 12344, 11977, 11256, 10477, 26452] },
  { year: 2090, male: [12229, 12199, 12146, 12238, 12514, 12794, 12964, 12963, 12850, 12774, 12744, 12684, 12507, 12084, 11285, 10234, 23877], female: [11673, 11646, 11600, 11714, 12022, 12332, 12528, 12551, 12465, 12418, 12430, 12434, 12348, 12033, 11365, 10476, 26750] },
  { year: 2091, male: [12238, 12223, 12179, 12257, 12507, 12786, 12974, 12995, 12883, 12785, 12738, 12678, 12521, 12140, 11384, 10261, 23954], female: [11683, 11671, 11635, 11734, 12015, 12324, 12536, 12581, 12496, 12428, 12423, 12428, 12360, 12088, 11464, 10502, 26813] },
  { year: 2092, male: [12248, 12241, 12205, 12275, 12502, 12778, 12978, 13024, 12920, 12799, 12733, 12671, 12529, 12187, 11482, 10351, 23994], female: [11693, 11690, 11662, 11753, 12010, 12314, 12538, 12607, 12530, 12441, 12418, 12419, 12365, 12132, 11559, 10590, 26847] },
  { year: 2093, male: [12255, 12254, 12222, 12288, 12497, 12767, 12975, 13045, 12956, 12816, 12729, 12661, 12530, 12224, 11575, 10482, 24050], female: [11700, 11702, 11678, 11766, 12005, 12303, 12534, 12626, 12563, 12455, 12411, 12407, 12363, 12163, 11646, 10717, 26912] },
  { year: 2094, male: [12255, 12261, 12229, 12292, 12491, 12754, 12967, 13058, 12988, 12833, 12725, 12648, 12524, 12250, 11659, 10620, 24177], female: [11700, 11708, 11683, 11767, 11998, 12288, 12524, 12636, 12590, 12468, 12403, 12389, 12351, 12183, 11723, 10849, 27069] },
  { year: 2095, male: [12245, 12263, 12225, 12285, 12481, 12736, 12951, 13062, 13011, 12851, 12721, 12631, 12511, 12266, 11732, 10748, 24413], female: [11688, 11708, 11675, 11757, 11985, 12268, 12505, 12635, 12608, 12479, 12393, 12365, 12331, 12191, 11786, 10967, 27363] },
  { year: 2096, male: [12242, 12281, 12258, 12313, 12485, 12725, 12944, 13072, 13044, 12884, 12733, 12628, 12508, 12281, 11786, 10837, 24506], female: [11686, 11726, 11709, 11784, 11988, 12256, 12496, 12643, 12638, 12511, 12404, 12361, 12326, 12203, 11840, 11059, 27439] },
  { year: 2097, male: [12240, 12290, 12282, 12336, 12492, 12715, 12933, 13075, 13071, 12921, 12748, 12625, 12504, 12291, 11834, 10934, 24620], female: [11684, 11735, 11733, 11808, 11994, 12245, 12485, 12644, 12663, 12545, 12417, 12357, 12319, 12211, 11886, 11155, 27549] },
  { year: 2098, male: [12234, 12292, 12295, 12352, 12500, 12704, 12919, 13070, 13092, 12957, 12765, 12622, 12497, 12296, 11876, 11032, 24783], female: [11679, 11737, 11746, 11823, 12001, 12234, 12469, 12638, 12681, 12577, 12431, 12351, 12309, 12212, 11922, 11250, 27724] },
  { year: 2099, male: [12221, 12287, 12297, 12357, 12506, 12694, 12901, 13058, 13104, 12988, 12783, 12620, 12486, 12295, 11910, 11127, 25016], female: [11667, 11732, 11747, 11827, 12006, 12223, 12450, 12624, 12689, 12604, 12445, 12344, 12294, 12205, 11949, 11337, 27992] },
  { year: 2100, male: [12197, 12276, 12288, 12352, 12506, 12682, 12879, 13040, 13105, 13011, 12801, 12616, 12471, 12288, 11935, 11213, 25348], female: [11642, 11720, 11734, 11818, 12003, 12209, 12426, 12603, 12686, 12621, 12456, 12335, 12272, 12190, 11965, 11412, 28385] }
];

// Totals by year for the population chart. From this year on, the line is a projection: dashed and paler
var currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
var totalsData = populationData.map(function(row) {
  return {
    year: row.year,
    male: sum(row.male),
    female: sum(row.female),
    lineSettings: row.year == currentYear ? { strokeDasharray: [3, 3], strokeOpacity: 0.3, fillOpacity: 0.3 } : undefined
  };
});

// One row per age group for the pyramid; female values are negative, so their bars grow to the left
function getPyramidData(year) {
  var row = populationData.find(function(item) { return item.year == year; });
  return ageGroups.map(function(age, i) {
    return { age: age, male: row.male[i], female: -row.female[i] };
  });
}

// adds up an array of numbers
function sum(values) {
  return values.reduce(function(total, value) { return total + value; }, 0);
}

// Create root element
// https://www.amcharts.com/docs/v5/getting-started/#Root_element
var root = am5.Root.new("chartdiv");

// Set themes
// https://www.amcharts.com/docs/v5/concepts/themes/
root.setThemes([
  am5themes_Animated.new(root),
  am5themes_Responsive.new(root)
]);

// The data is in thousands: show 1,000 as "1M", without the minus sign of the female values
root.numberFormatter.setAll({
  numberFormat: "#,###.#as", // a: the big-number suffix below; s: no minus sign
  bigNumberPrefixes: [
    { "number": 1e+3, "suffix": "M" }
  ]
});

// Create wrapper for charts
var container = root.container.children.push(am5.Container.new(root, {
  width: am5.p100,              // fills the whole chart area
  height: am5.p100,
  layout: root.horizontalLayout // the pyramid and the population chart side by side
}));

// ==========================================
// Pyramid chart
// ==========================================

// Create chart
// https://www.amcharts.com/docs/v5/charts/xy-chart/
var pyramidChart = container.children.push(
  am5xy.XYChart.new(root, {
    width: am5.p50,             // half the width
    panX: false,                // no dragging the plot
    panY: false,
    wheelX: "none",             // the mouse wheel scrolls the page, not the chart
    wheelY: "none",
    layout: root.verticalLayout // the header above the plot
  })
);

// Add a header above the pyramid: "Females" on the left, the year shown in the middle, "Males" on the right
var pyramidHeader = pyramidChart.children.unshift(am5.Container.new(root, {
  width: am5.p100 // the header spans the chart's width
}));

var femaleLabel = pyramidHeader.children.push(am5.Label.new(root, {
  text: "Females",
  fontSize: 16,     // 16px text...
  centerY: am5.p50, // ...its middle...
  y: am5.p50,       // ...halfway down the header...
  fill: pyramidChart.get("colors").getIndex(1) // ...in the color of the female bars
}));

var pyramidTitle = pyramidHeader.children.push(am5.Label.new(root, {
  text: currentYear + "",
  fontSize: 20,    // 20px text...
  x: am5.p50,      // ...centered...
  centerX: am5.p50 // ...by its own middle
}));

var maleLabel = pyramidHeader.children.push(am5.Label.new(root, {
  text: "Males",
  fontSize: 16,      // 16px text...
  x: am5.p100,       // ...at the right edge...
  centerX: am5.p100, // ...aligned by its own right edge...
  centerY: am5.p50,  // ...vertically centered...
  y: am5.p50,
  fill: pyramidChart.get("colors").getIndex(0) // ...in the color of the male bars
}));

// Create axes
// https://www.amcharts.com/docs/v5/charts/xy-chart/axes/
var pyramidXAxis = pyramidChart.xAxes.push(
  am5xy.ValueAxis.new(root, {
    // the same reach on both sides of zero, so the two halves of the pyramid compare
    min: -15000,
    max: 15000,
    strictMinMax: true,
    renderer: am5xy.AxisRendererX.new(root, {
      minGridDistance: 50, // at least 50px between value labels
      strokeOpacity: 0.1   // a faint axis line
    })
  })
);

var yRenderer = am5xy.AxisRendererY.new(root, {
  minGridDistance: 10 // labels may sit 10px apart, so every age group gets one
});

yRenderer.grid.template.setAll({
  location: 1 // grid lines at the end of each age group's row, between the bars
});

var pyramidYAxis = pyramidChart.yAxes.push(
  am5xy.CategoryAxis.new(root, {
    categoryField: "age",
    renderer: yRenderer
  })
);

// Add series
// https://www.amcharts.com/docs/v5/charts/xy-chart/series/
var pyramidSeriesMale = pyramidChart.series.push(
  am5xy.ColumnSeries.new(root, {
    name: "Males",
    xAxis: pyramidXAxis,
    yAxis: pyramidYAxis,
    categoryYField: "age",
    valueXField: "male",
    // not side by side: both series fill the whole row, males right of zero and females left
    clustered: false,
    tooltip: am5.Tooltip.new(root, {
      labelText: "Males, {categoryY}: {valueX}" // as "Males, 20-24: 11.4M"
    })
  })
);

var pyramidSeriesFemale = pyramidChart.series.push(
  am5xy.ColumnSeries.new(root, {
    name: "Females",
    xAxis: pyramidXAxis,
    yAxis: pyramidYAxis,
    categoryYField: "age",
    valueXField: "female",
    clustered: false, // the same rows as the male bars
    tooltip: am5.Tooltip.new(root, {
      labelText: "Females, {categoryY}: {valueX}" // no minus sign: the number format's s drops it
    })
  })
);

var pyramidData = getPyramidData(currentYear);
pyramidYAxis.data.setAll(pyramidData);
pyramidSeriesMale.data.setAll(pyramidData);
pyramidSeriesFemale.data.setAll(pyramidData);

// Add cursor
// https://www.amcharts.com/docs/v5/charts/xy-chart/cursor/
var pyramidCursor = pyramidChart.set("cursor", am5xy.XYCursor.new(root, {
  xAxis: pyramidXAxis,
  yAxis: pyramidYAxis
}));
pyramidCursor.lineX.set("visible", false); // no vertical cursor line...
pyramidCursor.lineY.set("visible", false); // ...and no horizontal one

// Show another year: the bars grow or shrink to its values
var shownYear = currentYear;
function showYear(year) {
  if (year == shownYear || year < 1950 || year > 2100) {
    return;
  }
  shownYear = year;
  var data = getPyramidData(year);
  am5.array.each(data, function(row, i) {
    pyramidSeriesMale.data.setIndex(i, row);
    pyramidSeriesFemale.data.setIndex(i, row);
  });
  pyramidTitle.set("text", year + "");

  // Late in the projection the 80+ group outgrows the axis: widen it in steps of 5M, so no bar is cut
  var largest = 0;
  am5.array.each(data, function(row) {
    largest = Math.max(largest, row.male, -row.female);
  });
  var limit = Math.max(15000, Math.ceil(largest / 5000) * 5000);
  if (limit != pyramidXAxis.get("max")) {
    pyramidXAxis.setAll({ min: -limit, max: limit });
  }
}

// ==========================================
// Population chart
// ==========================================

// Create chart
// https://www.amcharts.com/docs/v5/charts/xy-chart/
var popChart = container.children.push(
  am5xy.XYChart.new(root, {
    width: am5.p50,             // half the width
    panX: false,                // no dragging the plot
    panY: false,
    wheelX: "none",             // the mouse wheel scrolls the page, not the chart
    wheelY: "none",
    layout: root.verticalLayout // the title above the plot
  })
);

// Add title
var popTitle = popChart.children.unshift(am5.Label.new(root, {
  text: "U.S. population",
  fontSize: 20,    // 20px text...
  x: am5.p50,      // ...centered...
  centerX: am5.p50 // ...by its own middle
}));

// Create axes: years on a value axis
// https://www.amcharts.com/docs/v5/charts/xy-chart/axes/
var popXAxis = popChart.xAxes.push(
  am5xy.ValueAxis.new(root, {
    min: 1950,          // the years from 1950...
    max: 2100,          // ...to 2100...
    strictMinMax: true, // ...exactly, not rounded out
    numberFormat: "#",  // years without a thousands separator
    renderer: am5xy.AxisRendererX.new(root, {
      minGridDistance: 50 // at least 50px between year labels
    }),
    tooltip: am5.Tooltip.new(root, {}) // shows the year at the cursor
  })
);

var popYAxis = popChart.yAxes.push(
  am5xy.ValueAxis.new(root, {
    min: 0, // start at zero
    maxDeviation: 0.1,
    renderer: am5xy.AxisRendererY.new(root, {
      opposite: true // on the right side
    })
  })
);

// Add series: males and females, stacked
// https://www.amcharts.com/docs/v5/charts/xy-chart/series/
var popSeriesMale = popChart.series.push(
  am5xy.LineSeries.new(root, {
    name: "Males",
    xAxis: popXAxis,
    yAxis: popYAxis,
    valueYField: "male",
    valueXField: "year",
    stacked: true
  })
);

var popSeriesFemale = popChart.series.push(
  am5xy.LineSeries.new(root, {
    name: "Females",
    xAxis: popXAxis,
    yAxis: popYAxis,
    valueYField: "female",
    valueXField: "year",
    stacked: true, // the female area sits on top of the male one
    tooltip: am5.Tooltip.new(root, {
      pointerOrientation: "horizontal", // the tooltip points sideways, not down at the line
      labelText: "[bold]U.S. population in {valueX.formatNumber('#')}[/]\nMales: {male}\nFemales: {female}"
    })
  })
);

// Lines and fills; the current year's settings (in the data) start the dashed, paler projection
am5.array.each([popSeriesMale, popSeriesFemale], function(series) {
  series.strokes.template.setAll({
    strokeWidth: 2, // 2px lines
    templateField: "lineSettings"
  });
  series.fills.template.setAll({
    visible: true,    // shown (line series fills are hidden by default)
    fillOpacity: 0.5, // half see-through
    templateField: "lineSettings"
  });
  series.data.setAll(totalsData);
});

// Add cursor: moving it over a year shows that year in the pyramid
// https://www.amcharts.com/docs/v5/charts/xy-chart/cursor/
var popCursor = popChart.set("cursor", am5xy.XYCursor.new(root, {
  xAxis: popXAxis,
  yAxis: popYAxis
}));
popCursor.lineY.set("visible", false); // no horizontal cursor line

popCursor.events.on("cursormoved", function(ev) {
  var x = ev.target.getPrivate("positionX");
  showYear(Math.round(popXAxis.positionToValue(x)));
});

// Make stuff animate on load
// https://www.amcharts.com/docs/v5/concepts/animations/
pyramidSeriesMale.appear(1000, 100);
pyramidSeriesFemale.appear(1000, 100);
popSeriesMale.appear(1000, 100);
popSeriesFemale.appear(1000, 100);
pyramidChart.appear(1000, 100);
popChart.appear(1000, 100);
```
